title: test(perf): gate the workflow-run discovery scan
context:
find_conversations now attaches Workflow-tool runs from
<project>/<sid>/subagents/workflows/<run>/. That scan sits on the
all-conversations path, so it needs the same candidacy gate as every other
per-session walk here: a call-count bound, not a latency one.
